name: GeorgeCodingAgent
description: Coding agent for Claude Code and other tools: a coding worker, a read-only reviewer, and the plan, build, verify, review and ship skills they use. Works on its own.
summary: a coding worker, a read-only reviewer, and plan, build, review and ship skills

agents.name: coding
agents.summary: coding worker that builds or fixes code one verified slice at a time
agents.dispatch_when: implement, fix, refactor, test or build work in a code repo

agents.name: reviewer
agents.summary: fresh-context read-only reviewer that grades a diff, doc or plan against its contract and a checklist
agents.dispatch_when: a diff, doc or plan needs an adversarial review
